title: Memcached Protocol
description: Full compatibility with the standard memcached text protocol, enabling seamless integration with existing memcached clients and tools. Supports SET, GET, DELETE, and more commands out of the box.

title: Persistent Storage
description: Unlike traditional memcached, MirDB persists data to disk using SSTables (Sorted String Tables). Your data survives server restarts with efficient on-disk storage format.

title: LSM Tree Architecture
description: Built on a Log-Structured Merge-tree approach optimized for write-heavy workloads. Data flows from in-memory memtables to immutable SSTables with background compaction.

title: Skip List Memtable
description: High-performance skip list data structure powers the in-memory memtable, providing O(log n) average-case operations for inserts, lookups, and deletions.

title: Multi-level Compaction
description: Intelligent background compaction merges SSTables across multiple levels, optimizing storage space and read performance while maintaining data consistency.
